item.title: DevPulse 0.14.0
item.description:
• A new look, "Lookout", for the menu bar popover and the quick launcher. Every row says what it is on the left, with an icon and a coloured label (PR, Review, Jira, Claude), and its state on the right as a shape and a word; a pull request shows its CI and its review state separately. A Claude Code session waiting for you stands out with an amber bar.
  • The quick launcher is a Spotlight-like panel with the DevPulse mark next to the search field: only the search bar until you type, then the results, the detail with a button that opens the item and its related items joined by a thin line, and a line of keys at the bottom that says where Enter goes.
